verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that explicitly lists Issuing among its covered docs. Many Issuing doc citations resolve to agent-friendly .md page URLs (e.g., relayed-authorisation.md, manage-cards.md), so an agent can be pointed at markdown docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, detail on the llms.txt's Issuing coverage depth, and a consistent .md variant for the Issuing landing page (the /issuing/.md probe returned 404).
